entries.mechanism: EUROMOD BE_2025 tsceesp_be exceeds the Law of 30 March 1994 Article 108 single-household maximum: the statute caps the contribution at 731.28 EUR above 60,181.95 EUR household income, which is what the source-backed RuleSpec returns for the bridged il_taxabley base of 67,440.48 EUR.

EUROMOD BE_2025 returns the flat 123.95 EUR band value and does not apply the statutory joint-assessment 1.3 percent band above 21,070.96 EUR. The Axiom value reproduces the Article 108 middle band exactly from the bridged il_taxabley base.

Same missing joint 1.3 percent band in the middle of the Article 108 schedule: EUROMOD stays at the flat 123.95 EUR value while the Axiom value reproduces the statutory band formula exactly from the bridged il_taxabley base.

Article 108 sets a joint-assessment plateau of 632.39 EUR from 60,181.96 through 74,688.00 EUR household income; the bridged il_taxabley base of 64,268.32 EUR sits inside that plateau, so the source-backed RuleSpec returns 632.39. EUROMOD BE_2025 instead starts its 1.3 percent band in the plateau range.
